agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on October 25, 2023 in Community and Protective Services Committee Report 7.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, October 18, 2023, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Thurday, October 19, 2023.
agenda_items.minutes:
This draft Minutes document contains a summary of the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the final Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in this draft Minutes document are draft until the Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The final draft Minutes will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.
Chair’s Announcement
Prior to the consideration of regular agenda items, Chair Brockington announced that Thursday, 19 October 2023 was ‘Great Shakeout Day’, a day to learn and practice how to protect oneself in the event of earthquakes or other emergency situations.

sub_agendas_items.title: Safe Alternate Transportation Pilot

attachments.attachment_title: 7.1 - IPD - ACS2023-EPS-OPS-0003 - Safe Alternate Transportation Pilot (Revised).pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Chair Brockington asked for the Committee’s concurrence to add this item to the agenda for discussion. 
Mr. Kim Ayotte, General Manager, Emergency and Protective Services Department (EPSD) introduced Mr. Pierre Poirier, Chief, Ottawa Paramedic Service, EPSD, who appeared before Committee to respond to questions.  In response to a request for updates on the pilot program, Mr. Ayotte said the department could report back either through its annual reporting process, or semi-annually.

motions.motion_text:
That, pursuant to Subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being By-law NO2022-410), the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee approve that the Rules of Procedure be suspended to allow for the following item to be lifted onto consideration of the item listed as:
7.1      Safe Alternate Transportation Pilot (ACS2023-EPS-OPS-0003)
